notes:
I couldn't do this research, so I have no verse-by-verse notes for 2 Chronicles 7.

My first and only research step tried to open five commentary pages and run six searches. They were Enduring Word on 2 Chronicles 7, the Bible Hub commentary pages for 7:1 and 7:14, Gill's commentary on StudyLight, and Precept Austin's 2 Chronicles 7 page. The step crashed because of a bug in my code before any results were shown to me. The tool then told me I had no more research calls left this turn, so I couldn't fix the bug or try again. My other tools have no internet access.

So I haven't read anything from the approved sites. Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say, give a URL for every point and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. Writing the commentary anyway would mean making up sources, so I've left it all out.

If you ask again in a new message, I can start over and work through it in this order:
1. **The traditional reading of each verse:** Enduring Word, Bible Hub (Ellicott, Pulpit Commentary, Gill and others) and Precept Austin.
2. **Where Protestant traditions differ:** mainly v. 14 ("if My people… heal their land"). That means checking how Got Questions, Desiring God, The Gospel Coalition, Ligonier and Grace to You (gty.org), Seedbed, the Assemblies of God site (ag.org) and the LCMS site apply it to the church or to nations.
3. **Other views:** NET Bible notes, Bible Odyssey, New Advent and Catholic.com, and anything the sites say about popular revival or prosperity readings of v. 14.
